description: Figure 10 illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family, with error bars representing standard deviation. The horizontal axis displays language families, labeled in the order: Baltic, Slavic, Romance, Germanic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the effect of context masking, ranging from -0.12 to 0.14, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02.  For each language family, there are two bars: one representing TARG, colored light gray, and one representing PERMUTE, colored dark gray. The TARG bars have approximate values of 0.02 for Baltic, 0.04 for Slavic, 0.06 for Romance, 0.08 for Germanic, and 0.02 for Uralic. The PERMUTE bars have approximate values of 0.12 for Baltic, 0.10 for Slavic, 0.08 for Romance, 0.10 for Germanic, and 0.14 for Uralic. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each language family, allowing for a visual comparison of TARG and PERMUTE within each family. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
